answer: Each identity pays a non-refundable 45-credit levy per epoch, carved on a public marble ledger anyone can audit. One key funding k identities pays 45+6(k-1) per head, so 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 plus 70,000 in bonds against a 40,000 pool. Each payment earns a plume-stamped receipt; only holders claim rewards, and identities lacking one lose their bond. Rented payers still burn their own levy. Honest agents pay 45 once and share the nectar pool.
